{{Quote|Name's Whisper. My boss needs to speak with you. Top priority.|Whisper|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Whisper''' was the codename of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the intelligence agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], active during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. When the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] was overtaken by an [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], Whisper was dispatched by [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Rannos]] to recruit aid.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Whisper introduces Republic players to the Kaon Under Siege Flashpoint, which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1. According to the game's text files, Whisper was originally a droid named W6-S4.<ref name="TOR" />
